feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 1 September 2026 11:32am
items.description:
##Today##

Sunny intervals with a risk of isolated showers at first, this becoming more likely later in the afternoon & during the evening. Widespread rain arrives tonight & into Wednesday morning.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15-20, decreasing 10-15 in the evening, backing S or SE overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers. Hill fog at times, becoming persistent later.


##Tomorrow##

A wet morning, rain turning heavy at times before slowly clearing in the afternoon, leaving sunny intervals later. Clear intervals overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-8, risk of 15 on hills


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SE 10-15, veering SW by midday, then increasing W 20-25 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds later.


##Thursday, 3 September 2026##

Sunny intervals, turning cloudy in the afternoon with rain arriving by the evening, clearing late in the night.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

4-8


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain. Hill fog later..


##Comments##

Strong wind in places at first.
